description: Verify that ARP-detected address-in-use → DHCPDECLINE + restart configuration (DUT emits DISCOVER #2 after the DECLINE) (RFC 2131 §3.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Full recovery loop: when the post-BOUND ARP Probe collides, DUT must DECLINE the OFFER and then restart from INIT — i.e. emit a fresh DISCOVER. INIT_ALLOC_09 covers DECLINE; this case extends it to assert the restart actually happens.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND → DUT-emitted ARP Probe.
2. Tester → DUT: ARP Reply causing the conflict.
3. DUT → wire: DHCPDECLINE.
4. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER #2 (restart of configuration)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Full chain DISCOVER#1 → REQUEST → ARP_Probe → DECLINE → DISCOVER#2 observed.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing → corresponding Fail_no_* verdict.

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_arp_probe: No DUT ARP Probe after BOUND
verdicts.Fail_no_decline: No DUT DHCPDECLINE after ARP conflict
